name: MEGAFB
recent: Mega Fortris 近期出现多项股权变动，主席 Datuk Ng Meng Poh 与集团 CEO 分别减持约 2.1% 股权，控股股东 Mega Fortris Global 持股降至 62.9%。公司因股价波动多次被交易所暂停日内卖空，并接获异常市场活动询问。此外，公司有一项重大诉讼公告，以及 2026 财年末期股息每股 0.25 仙的派发安排。
notable: 主席 Datuk Ng Meng Poh 与集团 CEO 分别出售约 2.1% 股权，合计套现约 RM18.97 million。
控股股东 Mega Fortris Global 出售 1774 万股，持股比例降至 62.9%。
公司宣布 2026 财年末期股息每股 0.25 仙，除息日为 2026 年 10 月 20 日。
risks: 交易所多次暂停公司股票的日内卖空，并发出异常市场活动询问。
主席与集团 CEO 减持股份，控股股东持股比例下降。
公司存在重大诉讼事项。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季营收为 RM42.12 million，环比下降 7.6%，但同比增长 77.9%；净利为 RM3.50 million，净利率 8.3%，较上一季的 -0.3% 有所改善。

recent_en: Mega Fortris has seen several shareholding changes recently, with Chairman Datuk Ng Meng Poh and the Group CEO each disposing of about 2.1% stakes, while controlling shareholder Mega Fortris Global's stake fell to 62.9%. The stock faced repeated intraday short-selling suspensions and an unusual market activity query. The company also has a material litigation announcement and a final dividend of 0.25 sen per share for FY2026.
notable_en: Chairman Datuk Ng Meng Poh and the Group CEO each sold about 2.1% stakes, raising a combined approximately RM18.97 million.
Controlling shareholder Mega Fortris Global sold 17.74 million shares, reducing its stake to 62.9%.
The company declared a final dividend of 0.25 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 20 October 2026.
risks_en: The exchange suspended intraday short selling of the stock multiple times and issued an unusual market activity query.
The Chairman and Group CEO disposed of shares, and the controlling shareholder's stake declined.
The company has a material litigation matter.
earnings_en: 4Q FY2026 revenue was RM42.12 million, down 7.6% QoQ but up 77.9% YoY; net income was RM3.50 million with an 8.3% net margin, improving from -0.3% in the previous quarter.
